CATEGORY: 这个/这种 + N. must be clear (Coherence: reference)
definition: Use 这个, 这种, 这些, and 有的 only when the preceding context identifies exactly which entity or set they refer to.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (5 distinct):
1 | “这种植物” is unclear, sine preceding sentence has two types of plants
1 | “这个植物“ is not unclear, which one? Delete 是，Adj. can be predicate, without是
1 | “这个小孩子” is unclear and ambiguous
1 | otherwise unclear which house
1 | as “being picked up” already occurred, so it is not unknown “什么事情”, but a certain “这样的事情”.

HER CORRECTIONS (10 of 10):
[shennong_samples#50/f6/p0/note/e0] ⟦这种植物⟧原来是茶  || her note: “这种植物” is unclear, sine preceding sentence has two types of plants
[shennong_samples#45/f4/p0/note/e0] ⟦这个植物⟧的味道是最好  || her note: “这个植物“ is not unclear, which one? Delete 是，Adj. can be predicate, without是
[mengmu_samples#19/f0/p0/k0-1-2-3/e3] [这个小孩子→儿子]叫孟子  || her note: “这个小孩子” is unclear and ambiguous

[pear_story#4/f28/p0/k0/e0] 我完全没想到[什么事情→这样的事情]会立刻发生  || her note: as “being picked up” already occurred, so it is not unknown “什么事情”, but a certain “这样的事情”.
[shennong_samples#39/f1/p0/k1/e0] 还[有的→有些花]有毒
[shennong_samples#38/f7/p0/k0/e0] [+这个]图书馆只有木的书
[shennong_samples#25/f7/p1/k0/e0] 神农的朋友给他[这植物→灵芝]

[shennong_samples#50/f13/p0/k0/e1] [+那个]穿上一件蓝色的衣服的人

output.rule: Use 这个/这种/这些/有的 + N. only when the preceding context makes exactly which person, thing, place, or set clear. If it is already a known event, use 这样的 + N.; if the reference is unclear, name it more specifically.
output.explanation_template: <wrong reference> → <correct reference>: the preceding context does not identify exactly which <person/thing/place/set> this refers to.

examples.explanation: 这种植物 is unclear: the preceding sentence mentions two types of plants, so it does not identify which plant this means.
这个小孩子 → 儿子: 这个小孩子 is unclear and ambiguous; use the specific relationship.
小房子 → 这个小房子: use 这个 to show which house is meant.
什么事情 → 这样的事情: being picked up has already happened, so this is a certain 这样的事情, not an unknown 什么事情.

output.not_an_error: Do not flag 这个/这种/这些/有的 when the preceding context identifies exactly what it refers to. 这个 can be used when it makes the intended person, thing, or place clear.
